app.description: ERROR_REPORTS_APP_DSN is set: the phone app reports to POST /api/v1/errors/app

web.description: ERROR_REPORTS_WEB_DSN is set: the website reports to POST /api/v1/errors/web

ref.description: MDBList list id or mdblist.com/lists/<user>/<slug> link

client.description: the app, e.g. Kodi or Jellyfin Web

enabled.description: media libraries are set up on this install (MEDIA_URL)

problems.description: files that can't be read or matched

scan.description: the scan under way or asked for; left out when none

titles.description: films or shows found and matched

kind.description: movies or shows; left out when changing a library

readable.description: false: the file itself can't be read

can_remove.description: the person who added it, or an admin

delay_s.description: seconds; positive shows the lines later

kind.description: text (WebVTT) or ass, as the Watch tracks

in_jellyfin.description: Jellyfin has it: the outside players can play it

in_library.description: Movie Night's own library has it: Play here plays that copy

ref.description: the sender's own id for this play, to avoid duplicates

tmdb_id.description: movie id, or the show's id for an episode

tvdb_id.description: the show's TheTVDB id, for libraries scraped from TheTVDB

error_reports.description: Which clients may send crash reports to /api/v1/errors/{web,app}

oidc.description: OIDC is set up: the sign-in page (and /app/connect) offers it

ticket.description: the play's stream ticket: which file the subtitle is for

default.description: the person's subtitle language (Profile → Players), else en

enabled.description: false: no subtitle source is set up, and the player hides Search online

available.description: false while the source's download allowance is used up

hash_match.description: made for this very file (OpenSubtitles' moviehash)

id.description: the source's id; POST it back with source to add the subtitle

release.description: the release(s) it was made for, one per line

source.description: opensubtitles, subdl, subsource, jimaku, podnapisi or gestdown

hidden.description: machine-translated results left out (ask again with machine=true)

notes.description: sources that failed or are out of downloads, in plain words

audio_channels.description: the audio output's channels (AudioContext maxChannelCount); 6 or more keeps surround sound in a library transcode

direct_containers.description: containers the video element plays as a file

audio.description: audio track index; the file's default when left out

burn_subtitle.description: a picture subtitle (PGS, VobSub) to burn into the video

replace.description: the ticket of the play this continues

fonts.description: fonts embedded in the file, for styled subtitles

next.description: the episode after this one; left out at the end

resume_s.description: where the person left off; 0 from the start

source.description: where the file comes from: Movie Night's own library or Jellyfin

subtitle_index.description: the subtitle to show at the start

ticket.description: the stream ticket: in every stream address and every report

duration_s.description: the player's own length, used when the file's is unknown

transcoded.description: playing Jellyfin's HLS rather than the file

url.description: subtitles: where the player reads a text or ASS track

watched_at.description: ISO date or datetime; default now

post.description: Swap the one-time code from /app/connect for this device's token.

get.description:
How this Movie Night lets people sign in (no sign-in needed): the phone app shows its
username and password fields only when `password` is true, and starts its crash reports only
when `error_reports.app` is.
Finish the sign-in: exchange the code, read the ID token, sign in.

Send the person to the provider (a redirect). Where to come back to, the `next` query
parameter, is kept with the sign-in's state on the server.

post.description:
The phone app's username and password sign-in (PASSWORD_SIGNIN): the same device token
as /app/token. 404 when password sign-in is off, 401 for a wrong pair, 429 after five wrong
passwords for one username from one address (for 15 minutes; the sign-in page counts too).

get.description: Grid behind a row's "See all", one page at a time.
Watchlist / favourites / ratings as a grid.
Filtered TMDB browsing (the Discover tab); the same filters make a smart list.

post.description:
Takes a crash report from the phone app and forwards it to the collector
(no sign-in needed; no person is attached). Needs X-Requested-With: movienight. 404 when ERROR_REPORTS_APP_DSN
is empty, 413 over 200 KB, 400 for anything but an envelope, 429 over 20 reports from one
address in 10 minutes or 300 from everyone in an hour (the report is dropped).

requestBody.description: A Sentry envelope, at most 200 KB. Only its error events are forwarded.

post.description:
Takes a crash report from the website and forwards it to the collector
(no sign-in needed; no person is attached). Needs an Origin header naming this site. 404 when ERROR_REPORTS_WEB_DSN
is empty, 413 over 200 KB, 400 for anything but an envelope, 429 over 20 reports from one
address in 10 minutes or 300 from everyone in an hour (the report is dropped).

requestBody.description: A Sentry envelope, at most 200 KB. Only its error events are forwarded.

get.description: Everything Movie Night keeps for you, as one JSON file.
The tab's enabled rows, in order; the page then loads each one.
Movie Night's own media libraries, each with its counts and any scan under way.

post.description: Adds a library and asks for its first scan.

put.description: Matches a file to a TMDB title by hand, with every file named like it (a show's episodes). It stays over rescans.

delete.description: Removes a library from Movie Night. The files stay where they are.

put.description: Renames a library or changes its folders, and asks for a scan.

get.description: Files that can't be read, or whose name matched no film or show.

post.description: Scan now: a worker scans the library (only new and changed files are read).

patch.description: Rename (own lists), show on Home, star.

post.description: An editable copy of any list, as one of the person's own.
Add an MDBList list to the install's MDBList lists (kept in step daily).

get.description:
No query: MDBList's top lists. A link or list id: that list. Any other text: list search. Answered from
Movie Night's own copy while MDBList can't.
A list before following it: details and its titles as cards.

post.description:
Confirm the code Kodi (or another TV app) shows: it can then report
what you watch, and nothing else.
Last week's, month's or year's digest, made now if it doesn't exist yet.

Sign in to Jellyfin once; only the resulting token is kept (encrypted),
never the password.

A code to type into a Jellyfin app where you're signed in
(Settings → Quick Connect).

A new token for other players to report watches; shown once. Making a
new one turns the old one off.

put.description:
Report the time zone this browser or phone runs in (an IANA name such as
Europe/Berlin). History's days, "this year", the daily rows and the
digest periods follow it. An unknown name is refused (422); so is any
report while the person has a zone picked in Profile (409).

The person's own choice in Profile. mode "manual": keep time_zone (an IANA
name from GET /time-zones) whatever their devices report. mode
"automatic": follow their devices again, starting with time_zone, the zone
of the device this is sent from. An unknown name is refused (422).

get.description: Back in Movie Night: the Play to ask "Finished it?" about now, if any.

post.description: The player sent the person back from this Play: whether to ask now.

get.description:
Seerr requests, newest first (everyone's, or yours), with live status
and download progress: 40 a page, every page reachable ("more"), and
how many in all.

post.description:
Events from the Movie Night plugin for Jellyfin, for every app that
plays through Jellyfin: playback start, progress, pause and stop keep watch
progress; played and unplayed marks keep history. Same shared
secret as the webhook (X-MovieNight-Token).

get.description:
Your library, every rated title on TMDB (the catalog index: by meaning and keywords, so a described plot
works) and TMDB's live title search (new releases, exact names), ranked on one scale. `first` says which
section holds the best match. `page` 2, 3, ... answers with more of each section (the matches before
included); `more` says which have more.

The AI's best guess for a described plot (only when SEARCH_AI_MODEL is set): the films it names, as
cards, each with a few words on why.
The languages Search online offers, and the person's own (Profile → Players).

delete.description: Remove a stored subtitle for everyone: the person who added it, or an admin.

put.description: Set a stored subtitle's delay for every device.

get.description: A stored subtitle's text: WebVTT, or ASS for a styled one.

post.description: Pull your Jellyfin plays now (it also happens every few minutes).
Install-wide: rescan the Jellyfin library, or re-sync MDBList lists.

get.description:
Every time zone a person can pick in Profile (IANA names, sorted), with
each one's offset from UTC now.

delete.description:
Unlike one episode: its row is deleted. An episode that wasn't
liked is not an error.

post.description:
Like one episode (the heart on the season page). Liking it again
changes nothing. It doesn't favourite the show.

delete.description:
Remove one episode's rating: its row is deleted. An episode that
wasn't rated is not an error.

put.description:
Rate one episode, 1 to 10 like a title (the stars next to its heart on
the season page); rating it again replaces the rating. It doesn't rate
the show, and it isn't counted in Ratings, Your ratings, the community
average, the AI picks or digests.

post.description: Tick or untick episodes (a whole season is a list of them), all at once.

get.description: "More like this" and, for movies, the rest of the collection.

post.description:
Send the request to Seerr as this person. A 409 from Seerr (it already
has one) is not an error: the button moves to that request's status.
Shows can ask for some seasons only.

get.description:
IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and Trakt scores, and a
plain note when MDBList couldn't refresh them (it refused or didn't
answer).

Fresh request and download state, for the polling request button. Seerr's record is shared
by every poller for a few seconds (one call per title per window).
The subtitles added online for the file a play is showing, for everyone in the household.

post.description: Download a search result and keep it as a track of the playing file. 20 downloads an hour per person.

get.description: Search every subtitle source at once for the file a play is showing: made for this file first, then the release closest to its name, then the most downloaded. Machine-translated ones are left out unless machine=true. 30 searches an hour per person.

post.description: Play in the browser: how to stream the film or episode, its tracks, chapters and segments.
Posters for cards that arrived without one (big lists).
Where the player is: start, every few seconds, pause and stop. A stop at the end records the watch.
